hero.headline: Hi, I'am Atharv Randive AI/ML Developer

about.summary: Atharv is a B.Tech student in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning at Manipal University Jaipur. He is passionate about leveraging AI and ML to solve practical problems, and he has built projects ranging from space-tech machine learning to web applications for medical access and indoor navigation.

projects.name: Distributor Management Platform
projects.description: Built a full-stack web platform to digitize order collection for distributors and shopkeepers with online order placement, distributor dashboards, and real-time order tracking.

projects.name: Internship Studio 2.0
projects.description: Rebuilt an internship matcher as a semantic RAG system using parsed resumes, pgvector, and cosine similarity for grounded job matching.

projects.name: Multimodal Image Processing - Image Captioning
projects.description: Built a multimodal deep learning pipeline using CNN encoders and Transformer or LSTM decoders for image-to-text generation with attention mechanisms.

projects.name: NavPal - Indoor Navigation PWA
projects.description: Built an indoor navigation progressive web app for Manipal University Jaipur using QR anchor-based positioning and Dijkstra pathfinding with persistent map management.

projects.name: AI Spend Audit – Credix
projects.description: Built a full-stack AI spend audit tool that analyzes AI subscriptions and identifies overspending with shareable audit URLs and AI-generated summaries.

experience.role: ISRO Space Science Outreach & ML Research
experience.description: Conducted space science awareness sessions and developed an ML-based model for rocket thrust estimation and prediction using simulation and propulsion parameters.
Worked on machine learning algorithms including regression, clustering, SVM, and random forest, and built image-detection models with scikit-learn and TensorFlow.
